definition_notes: CDS B1 grand total = all UG (degree-seeking plus part-time 'other undergraduates enrolled in credit courses', 350 in Fall 2024) plus all graduate students including graduate students enrolled in credit courses outside a degree (Fall 2024 part-time 'All other graduates enrolled in credit courses' 478 men + 182 women), full- and part-time, headcount as of the official fall date. The CDS 2023-24 has no grand-total line, so the total is the sum of the UG (8,054) and graduate (10,392) lines.
caveats: CDS matches IPEDS: Fall 2023 18,446 vs 18,446; Fall 2022 18,283 vs 18,283.
Original-slide FY23 count was 17,529; the CDS Fall 2022 figure is 18,283, so the slide understated Stanford by 754 (4.1%).

Stanford CDS PDFs are hosted on Google Drive links from the IRDS page; the 2023-24 file is 48 pages and 2022-23 is 34 pages (layout differs by year) but all three are titled Stanford University Common Data Set for the correct year.
